description: This file defines the ReorderDisplays class, a Drupal form class for reordering display elements within the Views UI module, including form building and submission handling.

classes.name: ReorderDisplays
classes.description: A Drupal form class for reordering display elements in the Views UI module, handling form display and submission logic.

methods.name: getFormKey
methods.description: Returns the form key identifier for the reorder displays form.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique form ID for the reorder displays form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the reorder displays form, including display list, weights, and remove options.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating display order and deletion status, then caches and redirects.
